devdoc.details: Deployed once by RestaurantRegistry, so there is no owner and no setup step.      Payments are in the chain's native coin and go straight to the restaurant: this contract never      holds funds. Points are minted to the buyer in the same transaction as the payment.      Menu entries are never deleted, only hidden, so ids stay stable and old events stay meaningful.

params.name: Non-empty, at most `MAX_NAME_LENGTH` bytes. Cannot be changed later.
params.points: Points a customer earns per unit. Zero is allowed (an item that earns nothing).
params.price: Price of one unit in wei. Must not be zero.

params.cost: Points needed to claim it. Must not be zero.
params.name: Non-empty, at most `MAX_NAME_LENGTH` bytes. Cannot be changed later.

params.maxCost: The most points the caller agrees to pay. Protects against a cost change        between signing and mining.
params.token: The token to pay with. It must be accepted by `restaurant` right now.

purchase(address,uint256,uint256).details: The payment is forwarded to the restaurant and the points are minted to the caller.      Reverts, and so mints nothing, when the restaurant cannot receive the payment.      A restaurant cannot buy from itself: that would only mint points for free.      This does not stop one person from using a second wallet. What points are worth to other      restaurants is controlled by the acceptance policy of those restaurants.

updateItem(uint256,uint128,uint64,bool).details: A hidden item cannot be bought. Past purchases are not affected.

addItem(string,uint128,uint64).notice: Adds an item to the caller's menu. It starts available.

cancel(uint256).notice: Cancels a pending claim: the points are given back and the stock is restored.         Allowed for the restaurant and for the customer who made the claim.

claimReward(address,uint256,address,uint.notice: Spends points on a reward of `restaurant`. The points are burned and a pending claim         is created. The restaurant then calls `fulfill`, or `cancel` to give the points back.

fulfill(uint256).notice: Marks a pending claim as handed over. Only the restaurant that owns the reward.

getCustomerClaims(address).notice: Every claim made by `customer`, oldest first, with their ids.

getItems(address).notice: Every item of `restaurant`, hidden ones included. The index is the item id.

getRewards(address).notice: Every reward of `restaurant`, hidden ones included. The index is the reward id.

purchase(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Buys `quantity` of an item. Send exactly `price * quantity` wei.

registry().notice: The registry that knows the restaurants and their tokens.

updateReward(uint256,uint64,uint32,bool).notice: Changes the cost, the stock or the availability of one of the caller's rewards.

userdoc.notice: Where customers buy from restaurants and turn points into rewards.         Each restaurant keeps a menu (what it sells, the price, the points a purchase earns)         and a list of rewards (what points can be spent on, and how many).
